text:
zara: quick RFC follow-up — proposing an "attachment-first" upgrade pattern for air-gapped sites. idea: operator pulls a compact "activation artifact" (small manifest + checksums) into quarantine, runs lightweight validation, then streams component blobs only for VERIFIED components. objections?

otto: sounds promising. benefit being reduced disk pressure and ability to parallelize fetch+verify?

zara: exactly. two big wins: avoids full payload churn up-front; allows per-component parallel activation; better UX for constrained nodes.

li: tradeoffs: complexity in partial state and rollout semantics. how do we avoid half-applies leaving operators confused?

zara: operator keeps an ActivationPlan object (in-memory + persisted marker): states: PULLED -> ATTACHED -> QUARANTINED -> VERIFIED -> ACTIVATING -> ACTIVE. only when all targeted components in plan report ACTIVATING do we flip the activation marker. partial activations allowed but each component has its own small marker so rollbacks are bounded.

matt: how is rollback triggered? automatic on verification failure or manual?

zara: verifier retries transient errors. on hard REJECT we mark component RETIRED and emit an audit event. operator can either continue with other components or abort full activation depending on policy flag.

otto: sidecar vs builtin? sidecar seems to win for KMS/HSM separation.

zara: agree. sidecar handles heavy crypto + policy checks. operator stays stateless regarding keys. sidecar API minimal: VerifyCompact(manifest_hash, component_id, activation_id) -> {VERIFIED|REJECT|RETRY, reason}.

li: offline KMS? air-gapped customers need escrow path. propose: Escrow mode where admin injects signed escrow thumbprint and a human-ack record. first-time install requires explicit console approval.

zara: yes. escrow support should be opt-in and logged. include rotation via signed rotation manifests; rotation requires either prior key signature or maintenance-mode approval.

matt: GC behaviour? quarantine shouldn't fill SSDs. defaults?

zara: default TTL 48h, max_quarantine_bytes 1.5GB, max_items 4. eviction LRU by component_age and prefer non-activated. metrics: quarantine_bytes, quarantine_evictions_total.

otto: observability: include activation_span_id and compact_manifest_hash in all events and traces. makes replay and audit simpler.

li: API proto sketch? keep tiny.

```
syntax = "proto3";
service Verifier {
  rpc VerifyCompact(VerifyReq) returns (VerifyResp);
  rpc Health(Empty) returns (Health);
}
message VerifyReq { string manifest_hash = 1; string component_id = 2; string activation_id = 3; }
message VerifyResp { enum Status { UNKNOWN=0; VERIFIED=1; REJECTED=2; RETRY=3;} Status status = 1; string reason = 2; string sig_hash = 3; }
```

zara: rollout plan: 1) implement sidecar + operator hooks in read-only (simulated rejects) for 2 weeks on small canary; 2) enable quarantined attach for 10% of clusters with activation grace-window=5m; 3) expand to all after 3 weeks and minor tweaks.

eve: testing: add e2e that simulates low-disk and escrow rotation. also a chaos job that kills verifier mid-verify to ensure idempotency.

zara: good calls. next steps: i'll update the RFC with state diagram, proto, GC defaults, and escrow UX. ops-bot: please link RFC when posted.
